name: Mirrorthorn Splinter
description: A mirrored thorn shard honed for deceptive cuts.
specialEffects: Used in knives, reflective edgework, and feint-driven fittings.

steps: Refine raw stock for Mirrorthorn Splinter under controlled heat and pressure.
Fold and stabilize the blend until impurities are below forge tolerance.
Cast and cool using Mirrorthorn Refinery protocol before storage.
